description: This file defines a base class for media playback task tests in a GStreamer-based media pipeline. It includes setup and expectation methods for testing video and audio element configurations, callbacks, and task execution related to media setup, geometry, volume, and source attachment.

classes.name: TasksTestsBase
classes.description: A base class providing setup, expectation, and trigger methods for testing media pipeline tasks involving GStreamer elements, callbacks, and configurations.

methods.name: expectSetupVideoElement
methods.description: Sets expectations for configuring a video element, including factory checks and signal connections.

methods.name: expectSetupAudioElement
methods.description: Sets expectations for configuring an audio element, including factory checks and signal connections.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementOnly
methods.description: Prepares expectations for setting up a video element that is not Westerossink or Amlhalasink.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementWesterossink
methods.description: Prepares expectations for setting up a Westerossink video element with pending geometry.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementAmlhalasink
methods.description: Prepares expectations for setting up an Amlhalasink video element with specific object properties.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementPendingGeometryNonWesterissink
methods.description: Prepares expectations for setting up a video element with pending geometry when not Westerossink.

methods.name: shouldSetupAudioElementOnly
methods.description: Prepares expectations for setting up only an audio element.

methods.name: shouldSetVideoUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Asserts that the video underflow callback is set and schedules video underflow handling.

methods.name: triggerVideoUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Simulates invocation of the video underflow callback.

methods.name: shouldSetAudioUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Asserts that the audio underflow callback is set and schedules audio underflow handling.

methods.name: triggerAudioUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Simulates invocation of the audio underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerSetupElement
methods.description: Executes a SetupElement task to configure a media element.

methods.name: setPipelineToNull
methods.description: Sets the pipeline in the test context to null.

methods.name: triggerSetVideoGeometryFailure
methods.description: Executes a SetVideoGeometry task and verifies that pending geometry remains unchanged.

methods.name: shouldSetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Expects the setWesterossinkRectangle method to be called.

methods.name: triggerSetVideoGeometrySuccess
methods.description: Executes a SetVideoGeometry task and verifies that pending geometry is updated.

methods.name: setAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Marks all sources as attached in the test context.

methods.name: shouldScheduleAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Expects the scheduleAllSourcesAttached method to be called.

methods.name: triggerSetupSource
methods.description: Executes a SetupSource task and verifies source assignment.

methods.name: shouldSetGstVolume
methods.description: Expects the gstStreamVolumeSetVolume method to be called with specific parameters.

methods.name: triggerSetVolume
methods.description: Executes a SetVolume task to set the volume.
